name: e
doc: /-- The unit vector at angle `θ`: `e θ = exp (θ i) = cos θ + i sin θ`. -/
sig: noncomputable def e (θ : ℝ) : ℂ

name: norm_e
doc: /-- `e θ` has norm `1`. -/
sig: @[simp] theorem norm_e (θ : ℝ) : ‖e θ‖ = 1

name: e_eq
doc: /-- `e` in coordinates. -/
sig: theorem e_eq (θ : ℝ) : e θ = (Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * I

name: e_add
doc: /-- `e` turns sums into products: rotation by `α` is multiplication by `e α`. -/
sig: theorem e_add (α β : ℝ) : e (α + β) = e α * e β

name: e_add_two_pi
doc: /-- `e` has period `2π`. -/
sig: theorem e_add_two_pi (θ : ℝ) : e (θ + 2 * π) = e θ

name: ringPt
doc: /-- The point `r(θ)` of the ring `ω(p)`. -/
sig: noncomputable def ringPt (p : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) : ℂ

name: dist_ringPt
doc: /-- Ring points lie on the unit circle about their centre. -/
sig: @[simp] theorem dist_ringPt (p : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) : dist (ringPt p θ) p = 1

name: ringPt_mem_sphere
doc: /-- Ring points lie on `ω(p) = Metric.sphere p 1`. -/
sig: theorem ringPt_mem_sphere (p : ℂ) (θ : ℝ) : ringPt p θ ∈ Metric.sphere p 1

name: arcLength
doc: /-- Arc-length on the unit circle, in the angle parametrization: Lebesgue measure on `[0, 2π)`. -/
sig: noncomputable def arcLength : Measure ℝ

doc: /-- Arc-length is a finite measure (total mass `2π`), so products with it are well behaved. -/
sig: instance : IsFiniteMeasure arcLength
example : e 0 = 1

doc:
/-- Two ring points `60°` apart are at distance exactly `1` — the fact the whole ring calculus runs on
(FS116-V4-CHORD is its general form). -/
sig: example (p : ℂ) : dist (ringPt p (π / 3)) (ringPt p 0) = 1

doc: /-- Arc-length gives the whole circle `2π`. -/
sig: example : arcLength univ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * π)

name: unitPairSet
doc: /-- The unit pairs of `A`, as `(x, θ)` with both `x` and `x + e θ` in `A`. -/
sig: def unitPairSet (A : Set ℂ) : Set (ℂ × ℝ)

name: UnitPairsNull
doc: /-- `A` has null unit pairs: `(Leb ⊗ σ){(x, w) : x ∈ A, x + w ∈ A} = 0`. -/
sig: def UnitPairsNull (A : Set ℂ) : Prop

name: densityRatio
doc: /-- The ratio `|A ∩ B̄(x, r)| / |B̄(x, r)|` whose limits define density. -/
sig: noncomputable def densityRatio (A : Set ℂ) (x : ℂ) (r : ℝ) : ENNReal

name: densitySet
doc: /-- `Ã`: the points of Lebesgue density `1` of `A`. -/
sig: def densitySet (A : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ

name: upperDensityAt
doc: /-- `d̄_A(x)`: the upper density of `A` at `x`. -/
sig: noncomputable def upperDensityAt (A : Set ℂ) (x : ℂ) : ENNReal

name: essSupport
doc: /-- `supp A`: the points every open ball about which meets `A` in positive measure. -/
sig: def essSupport (A : Set ℂ) : Set ℂ

name: unitPairsNull_of_dist_lt_one
doc: /-- A set with no two points at distance `1` or more has no unit pairs at all. -/
sig: theorem unitPairsNull_of_dist_lt_one {A : Set ℂ} (h : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < 1) : UnitPairsNull A

name: unitPairSet_mono
doc: /-- Unit pairs are monotone in the set. -/
sig: theorem unitPairSet_mono {A B : Set ℂ} (h : A ⊆ B) : unitPairSet A ⊆ unitPairSet B

name: UnitPairsNull.mono
doc: /-- A subset of a set with null unit pairs has null unit pairs. -/
sig: theorem UnitPairsNull.mono {A B : Set ℂ} (hB : UnitPairsNull B) (h : A ⊆ B) : UnitPairsNull A

name: not_unitPairsNull_ball_two
doc:
/-- **Adversary**: a disc of radius `2` does not have null unit pairs — every `x` within `1/2` of the
centre has its whole unit circle inside, so the pair set holds a product of positive measure. -/
sig: theorem not_unitPairsNull_ball_two : ¬ UnitPairsNull (ball (0 : ℂ) 2)

name: densityRatio_univ
doc: /-- On a ball of positive radius the ratio of the whole plane is `1`. -/
sig: theorem densityRatio_univ (x : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : densityRatio univ x r = 1

name: continuous_e
doc: /-- `e` is continuous. -/
sig: theorem continuous_e : Continuous e

name: e_add_pi
sig: theorem e_add_pi (θ : ℝ) : e (θ + π) = - e θ

name: pairSet
doc: /-- The pairs `(x, θ)` with `x ∈ S` and `x + e θ ∈ T`; the unit pairs of `A` are `pairSet A A`. -/
sig: def pairSet (S T : Set ℂ) : Set (ℂ × ℝ)

name: unitPairSet_eq_pairSet
doc: /-- The unit pairs of `A` are the pairs from `A` to `A`. -/
sig: theorem unitPairSet_eq_pairSet (A : Set ℂ) : unitPairSet A = pairSet A A

name: measurableSet_pairSet
doc: /-- Pairs between measurable sets form a measurable set. -/
sig: theorem measurableSet_pairSet {S T : Set ℂ} (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T) : MeasurableSet (pairSet S T)

name: measurableSet_unitPairSet
doc: /-- The unit pairs of a measurable set form a measurable set. -/
sig: theorem measurableSet_unitPairSet {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) : MeasurableSet (unitPairSet A)

name: measurable_arcLength_slice
doc: /-- The direction set `{θ | p + e θ ∈ A}` has measurable arc-length in `p`. -/
sig: theorem measurable_arcLength_slice {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) : Measurable fun p : ℂ => arcLength {θ | p + e θ ∈ A}

name: pairSet_measure_eq_lintegral
doc:
/-- Tonelli in the point: the mass of the pairs from `S` to `T` is the integral over `S` of the arc-length of
the directions landing in `T`. -/
sig: theorem pairSet_measure_eq_lintegral {S T : Set ℂ} (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T) : (volume.prod arcLength) (pairSet S T) = ∫⁻ p in S, arcLength {θ | p + e θ ∈ T}

name: pairSet_null_iff_ae_slice
doc:
/-- Tonelli in the direction: the pairs from `S` to `T` are null iff for almost every direction `θ` the points
`x ∈ S` with `x + e θ ∈ T` are null. -/
sig: theorem pairSet_null_iff_ae_slice {S T : Set ℂ} (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hT : MeasurableSet T) : (volume.prod arcLength) (pairSet S T) = 0 ↔ ∀ᵐ θ ∂arcLength, volume {x : ℂ | x ∈ S ∧ x + e θ ∈ T} = 0

name: unitPairsNull_iff_ae_slice
doc: /-- A measurable `A` has null unit pairs iff almost every direction has a null set of unit pairs. -/
sig: theorem unitPairsNull_iff_ae_slice {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) : UnitPairsNull A ↔ ∀ᵐ θ ∂arcLength, volume {x : ℂ | x ∈ A ∧ x + e θ ∈ A} = 0

name: unitPairs_measure_eq_lintegral
doc: /-- Tonelli in the point, for the unit pairs. -/
sig: theorem unitPairs_measure_eq_lintegral {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) : (volume.prod arcLength) (unitPairSet A) = ∫⁻ p in A, arcLength {θ | p + e θ ∈ A}

name: volume_slice_swap
doc: /-- Translating by `e θ` swaps the two ends of a slice, at the opposite direction. -/
sig: theorem volume_slice_swap (S T : Set ℂ) (θ : ℝ) : volume {x : ℂ | x ∈ S ∧ x + e θ ∈ T} = volume {x : ℂ | x ∈ T ∧ x + e (θ + π) ∈ S}

doc: /-- A small disc has null unit pairs. -/
sig: example : UnitPairsNull (ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3))

doc: /-- Every point is a density point of the plane. -/
sig: example (x : ℂ) : x ∈ densitySet univ

doc: /-- **Adversary**: no point is a density point of the empty set. -/
sig: example (x : ℂ) : x ∉ densitySet ∅

doc: /-- The plane has upper density `1` everywhere. -/
sig: example (x : ℂ) : upperDensityAt univ x = 1

doc: /-- Every point is in the essential support of the plane, and none in that of the empty set. -/
sig: example (x : ℂ) : x ∈ essSupport univ ∧ x ∉ essSupport ∅

name: AeColouring
doc: /-- A Lebesgue-measurable `k`-colouring of the plane whose unit pairs are bichromatic almost everywhere. -/
sig: structure AeColouring (k : ℕ)

name: chiM0
doc: /-- `χ_m⁰(ℝ²)`: the least `k` admitting an `AeColouring k` (`⊤` if none). -/
sig: noncomputable def chiM0 : ℕ∞

name: chiM0_le
doc: /-- Any measurable colouring proper at almost every unit pair bounds `χ_m⁰(ℝ²)`. -/
sig: theorem chiM0_le {k : ℕ} (c : AeColouring k) : chiM0 ≤ k

doc: /-- No colouring with no colours. -/
sig: instance : IsEmpty (AeColouring 0)

doc: /-- **Adversary**: one colour never suffices — its class is the plane, which holds a disc of radius `2`. -/
sig: instance : IsEmpty (AeColouring 1)

doc: /-- Spec example: `χ_m⁰(ℝ²) ≥ 2`, from the two emptiness facts alone. -/
sig: example : 2 ≤ chiM0

name: Arc
doc: /-- A boundary arc: a segment `[a, b]`, or the circular arc `{c + ρ e(θ) : θ ∈ [θ₀, θ₁]}`. -/
sig: inductive Arc

name: carrier
doc: /-- The points of an arc. -/
sig: def carrier : Arc → Set ℂ | seg a b => segment ℝ a b | circ c ρ θ₀ θ₁ => (fun θ : ℝ => c + ρ * e θ) '' Icc θ₀ θ₁

name: Nondegenerate
doc: /-- An arc of positive length that is not a whole circle. -/
sig: def Nondegenerate : Arc → Prop | seg a b => a ≠ b | circ _ ρ θ₀ θ₁ => 0 < ρ ∧ θ₀ < θ₁ ∧ θ₁ ≤ θ₀ + 2 * π

name: IsUnitArc
doc: /-- A **unit arc**: a boundary arc of radius `1`. -/
sig: def IsUnitArc : Arc → Prop | seg _ _ => False | circ _ ρ _ _ => ρ = 1

name: ArcMap
doc:
/-- A `k`-coloured map of an open set `dom`, bounded by a locally finite family of segments and circular
arcs, its colour locally constant off them. -/
sig: structure ArcMap (k : ℕ)

name: Γ
doc: /-- `Γ`: the boundary arcs inside the domain. -/
sig: def Γ : Set ℂ

name: interiorPts
doc: /-- The interior points: the domain off the arcs (the union of the tiles). -/
sig: def interiorPts : Set ℂ

name: region
doc: /-- The interior points of colour `j`. -/
sig: def region (j : Fin k) : Set ℂ

name: IsTile
doc: /-- A **tile**: a connected component of the interior points. -/
sig: def IsTile (T : Set ℂ) : Prop

name: coloursAt
doc: /-- `P_cl(x)`: the colours whose region has `x` in its closure. -/
sig: def coloursAt (x : ℂ) : Set (Fin k)

name: Valid
doc: /-- **Valid**: no two interior points of one colour at distance exactly `1`. -/
sig: def Valid : Prop

name: Covers
doc: /-- The map is a fragment on the closed disc `B̄(p, R)`: its domain contains the disc. -/
sig: def Covers (p : ℂ) (R : ℝ) : Prop

name: IsPlaneMap
doc: /-- The map is a map of the whole plane. -/
sig: def IsPlaneMap : Prop

name: Siamese
doc: /-- A **Siamese pair**: two distinct tiles of one colour with every cross distance below `1`. -/
sig: def Siamese (T T' : Set ℂ) : Prop

name: NonSiamese
doc: /-- The map has no Siamese pair. -/
sig: def NonSiamese : Prop

name: IsJordanDomain
doc: /-- `T` is a Jordan domain: its closure is a closed disc with `T` as the disc's interior. -/
sig: def IsJordanDomain (T : Set ℂ) : Prop

name: Simple
doc: /-- **Simple**: every tile a Jordan domain, distinct tiles' closures meeting in a preconnected set. -/
sig: def Simple : Prop

name: interiorPts_of_arcs_empty
doc: /-- With no arcs, the interior points are the domain. -/
sig: theorem interiorPts_of_arcs_empty (h : F.arcs = ∅) : F.interiorPts = F.dom

name: const
doc: /-- The map of an open set with no arcs and one colour `j`. -/
sig: def const (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (j : Fin k) : ArcMap k

name: const_interiorPts
sig: @[simp] theorem const_interiorPts (U : Set ℂ) (hU : IsOpen U) (j : Fin k) : (const U hU j).interiorPts = U

name: im_eq_zero_of_mem_segment
doc: /-- A point of the closed segment `[-1/2, 1/2]` is real. -/
sig: theorem im_eq_zero_of_mem_segment {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ segment ℝ (-1 / 2 : ℂ) (1 / 2)) : z.im = 0

name: mem_segment_of_im_eq_zero
doc: /-- A real point of the disc of radius `1/3` lies on the segment `[-1/2, 1/2]`. -/
sig: theorem mem_segment_of_im_eq_zero {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ < 1 / 3) (him : z.im = 0) : z ∈ segment ℝ (-1 / 2 : ℂ) (1 / 2)

name: halfDisc
doc: /-- The disc of radius `1/3` split along the real axis: colour `1` above, `0` below. -/
sig: noncomputable def halfDisc : ArcMap 2

name: halfDisc_arcs_union
doc: /-- The arcs of `halfDisc` cover exactly the segment `[-1/2, 1/2]`. -/
sig: theorem halfDisc_arcs_union : ⋃ a ∈ halfDisc.arcs, a.carrier = segment ℝ (-1 / 2 : ℂ) (1 / 2)

name: halfDisc_mem_interiorPts
doc: /-- The interior points of `halfDisc` are the points of the disc off the real axis. -/
sig: theorem halfDisc_mem_interiorPts {z : ℂ} : z ∈ halfDisc.interiorPts ↔ ‖z‖ < 1 / 3 ∧ z.im ≠ 0

name: halfDisc_I_mul_mem
doc: /-- `i t` is an interior point of `halfDisc` for `0 < |t| < 1/3`. -/
sig: theorem halfDisc_I_mul_mem {t : ℝ} (h0 : t ≠ 0) (h1 : |t| < 1 / 3) : (t : ℂ) * I ∈ halfDisc.interiorPts

doc: /-- A one-colour fragment on a disc of radius `1/3` is valid: no two of its points are `1` apart. -/
sig: example : (ArcMap.const (ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3)) isOpen_ball (0 : Fin 1)).Valid

doc: /-- **Adversary**: a one-colour fragment on the unit disc is not valid (`±1/2` are `1` apart). -/
sig: example : ¬ (ArcMap.const (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) isOpen_ball (0 : Fin 1)).Valid

doc: /-- Both colours are at the origin of `halfDisc`: `P_cl(0) = {0, 1}`. -/
sig: example : halfDisc.coloursAt 0 = univ

name: halfDiscMono
doc: /-- `halfDisc` recoloured with one colour: the same two tiles, now a Siamese pair. -/
sig: noncomputable def halfDiscMono : ArcMap 2

name: halfDisc_component_upper
doc: /-- The tile of `halfDisc` through an upper interior point is the upper half-disc. -/
sig: theorem halfDisc_component_upper {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ halfDisc.interiorPts) (h : 0 < x.im) : connectedComponentIn halfDisc.interiorPts x = {z | ‖z‖ < 1 / 3 ∧ 0 < z.im}

name: halfDisc_component_lower
doc: /-- The tile of `halfDisc` through a lower interior point is the lower half-disc. -/
sig: theorem halfDisc_component_lower {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ halfDisc.interiorPts) (h : x.im < 0) : connectedComponentIn halfDisc.interiorPts x = {z | ‖z‖ < 1 / 3 ∧ z.im < 0}

doc: /-- `halfDisc` has no Siamese pair: its two tiles have different colours. -/
sig: example : halfDisc.NonSiamese

doc: /-- **Adversary**: recoloured with one colour, the two tiles of `halfDisc` are a Siamese pair. -/
sig: example : ¬ halfDiscMono.NonSiamese

doc: /-- A one-colour map of the open unit disc with no arcs is simple: its one tile is the disc. -/
sig: example (j : Fin 2) : (ArcMap.const (ball (0 : ℂ) 1) isOpen_ball j).Simple

name: phi
doc: /-- `φ_A(p)`: the arc-length of the directions from `p` that land in `A` at distance `1`. -/
sig: noncomputable def phi (A : Set ℂ) (p : ℂ) : ENNReal

name: IsMUA
doc:
/-- A **MUA set**: measurable, null unit pairs, and maximal up to null sets among measurable sets with null unit
pairs. -/
sig: def IsMUA (A : Set ℂ) : Prop

name: phi_univ
doc: /-- Spec: `φ` of the plane is the whole circle. -/
sig: theorem phi_univ (p : ℂ) : phi univ p = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi)

name: measurable_phi
doc: /-- `φ_A` is measurable for measurable `A`. -/
sig: theorem measurable_phi {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) : Measurable (phi A)

name: ae_arcLength_shift_pi
doc: /-- A null set of directions' shift by `Real.pi` is null, for `2Real.pi`-periodic data. -/
sig: theorem ae_arcLength_shift_pi (f : ℝ → ENNReal) (hper : ∀ θ, f (θ + 2 * Real.pi) = f θ) (h : ∀ᵐ θ ∂arcLength, f θ = 0) : ∀ᵐ θ ∂arcLength, f (θ + Real.pi) = 0

name: exists_ball_pos_inter
doc: /-- A set of positive measure meets some disc of radius `1/3` in a set of positive measure. -/
sig: theorem exists_ball_pos_inter {E : Set ℂ} (hE : 0 < volume E) : ∃ d : ℂ, 0 < volume (E ∩ ball d (1 / 3))

name: unitPairsNull_iff_ae_phi_eq_zero
doc: /-- **FS111-M2-ZERO**, unit-avoiding half: a measurable `A` has null unit pairs iff `φ_A = 0` almost everywhere on `A`. -/
sig: theorem unitPairsNull_iff_ae_phi_eq_zero {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) : UnitPairsNull A ↔ ∀ᵐ p ∂(volume.restrict A), phi A p = 0

name: isMUA_iff_ae_phi_pos
doc:
/-- **FS111-M2-ZERO**, maximal half: a measurable `A` with null unit pairs is a MUA set iff `φ_A > 0` almost
everywhere off `A`. -/
sig: theorem isMUA_iff_ae_phi_pos {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hnull : UnitPairsNull A) : IsMUA A ↔ ∀ᵐ p ∂(volume.restrict Aᶜ), 0 < phi A p

name: isMUA_iff_ae_eq
doc: /-- **FS111-M2-ZERO**: a measurable `A` is a MUA set iff `A = {φ_A = 0}` almost everywhere. -/
sig: theorem isMUA_iff_ae_eq {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) : IsMUA A ↔ A =ᵐ[volume] {p | phi A p = 0}

name: exists_angle_of_norm_eq_one
doc: /-- A unit complex number is `e θ₀` for some `θ₀ ∈ [0, 2π)`. -/
sig: theorem exists_angle_of_norm_eq_one {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : ∃ θ₀ ∈ Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi), z = e θ₀

name: exists_interval_near
doc: /-- A length-`r` half-open interval of angles inside `[0, 2π)` lies within `r` of any `θ₀ ∈ [0, 2π)` (`r ≤ π`). -/
sig: theorem exists_interval_near {θ₀ r : ℝ} (hθ₀ : θ₀ ∈ Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hr : 0 < r) (hrπ : r ≤ Real.pi) : ∃ a : ℝ, Ico a (a + r) ⊆ Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧ ∀ θ ∈ Ico a (a + r), |θ - θ₀| ≤ r

name: exists_mem_slice_null
doc: /-- In an interval of directions of positive length inside `[0, 2π)` some direction has a null slice of unit pairs. -/
sig: theorem exists_mem_slice_null {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hnull : UnitPairsNull A) {I : Set ℝ} (hI : MeasurableSet I) (hIsub : I ⊆ Ico 0 (2 * Real.pi)) (hpos : 0 < volume I) : ∃ θ ∈ I, volume {x : ℂ | x ∈ A ∧ x + e θ ∈ A} = 0

name: measure_inter_closedBall_le
doc: /-- The heart of I-D1: with a null slice at direction `θ` near `θ₀`, the mass of `A` in the ball about `x` is at most the mass of the complement of `A` in the doubled ball about `y = x + e θ₀`. -/
sig: theorem measure_inter_closedBall_le {A : Set ℂ} {x y : ℂ} {r θ θ₀ : ℝ} (hy : y = x + e θ₀) (hθ : ‖e θ - e θ₀‖ ≤ r) (hslice : volume {z : ℂ | z ∈ A ∧ z + e θ ∈ A} = 0) : volume (A ∩ closedBall x r) ≤ volume (closedBall y (2 * r) \ A)

name: volume_real_closedBall
doc: /-- The area of a closed ball in `ℂ`, as `r² ·` (area of the unit ball). -/
sig: theorem volume_real_closedBall (z : ℂ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : volume.real (closedBall z r) = r ^ 2 * volume.real (closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1)

name: volume_real_closedBall_one_pos
doc: /-- The unit ball has positive finite area. -/
sig: theorem volume_real_closedBall_one_pos : 0 < volume.real (closedBall (0 : ℂ) 1)

name: preconnected_dist_lt_or_gt
doc: /-- A preconnected set never at distance `1` from `x` lies entirely inside or entirely outside the unit sphere. -/
sig: theorem preconnected_dist_lt_or_gt {S : Set ℂ} (hS : IsPreconnected S) {x : ℂ} (h : ∀ s ∈ S, dist x s ≠ 1) : (∀ s ∈ S, dist x s < 1) ∨ (∀ s ∈ S, 1 < dist x s)

name: dist_ne_one_of_mem_densitySet
doc:
/-- **I-D1, set form** (FS111-V0-ID1's argument; G92's widened form): for a measurable `A` with null unit pairs, a
density point `y` of `A` and a point `x` of positive upper density are not at distance `1`. -/
sig: theorem dist_ne_one_of_mem_densitySet {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hnull : UnitPairsNull A) {x y : ℂ} (hy : y ∈ densitySet A) (hx : 0 < upperDensityAt A x) : dist x y ≠ 1

name: AeColouring.dist_ne_one
doc:
/-- **FS111-V0-ID1** (I-D1): in every measurable colouring proper at almost every unit pair, if `y ∈ S̃_j` and
`d̄_j(x) > 0` then `|x − y| ≠ 1`. -/
sig: theorem AeColouring.dist_ne_one {k : ℕ} (c : AeColouring k) (j : Fin k) {x y : ℂ} (hy : y ∈ densitySet (c.col ⁻¹' {j})) (hx : 0 < upperDensityAt (c.col ⁻¹' {j}) x) : dist x y ≠ 1

name: upperDensityAt_pos_of_mem_densitySet
doc: /-- A density point has positive upper density (it has upper density `1`). -/
sig: theorem upperDensityAt_pos_of_mem_densitySet {A : Set ℂ} {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ densitySet A) : 0 < upperDensityAt A x

name: hullset
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR2-HULLSET**, first clause (with FS111-C-HULL merged into it): for a measurable `A` with null unit pairs,
every preconnected `C ⊆ Ã` and every `x` with `d̄_A(x) > 0`, either every point of `C` is within distance below `1`
of `x` or every point of `C` is farther than `1`. (The row says path-connected; the argument reads only
preconnectedness — a generalization, reported.) -/
sig: theorem hullset {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hnull : UnitPairsNull A) {C : Set ℂ} (hC : IsPreconnected C) (hCA : C ⊆ densitySet A) {x : ℂ} (hx : 0 < upperDensityAt A x) : (∀ c ∈ C, dist x c < 1) ∨ (∀ c ∈ C, 1 < dist x c)

name: hullset_of_isCompact
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR2-HULLSET**, second clause: when `C` is moreover compact, the bound is uniform — `sup_{c ∈ C} |x − c| < 1`
or `dist(x, C) > 1`, written with explicit bounds so that an empty `C` reads no junk value. -/
sig: theorem hullset_of_isCompact {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hnull : UnitPairsNull A) {C : Set ℂ} (hC : IsPreconnected C) (hCc : IsCompact C) (hCA : C ⊆ densitySet A) {x : ℂ} (hx : 0 < upperDensityAt A x) : (∃ r < 1, ∀ c ∈ C, dist x c ≤ r) ∨ (∃ r > 1, ∀ c ∈ C, r ≤ dist x c)

name: hull2
doc:
/-- **FS111-M-HULL2**: two preconnected pieces of one class — `P` of points of positive upper density, `Q` of density
points — have all cross distances below `1` or all above `1`. (The row says "path-connected pieces of one class"; its
`uses only:` reads C-HULL at each point of one piece and path-connectedness of the other.) -/
sig: theorem hull2 {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hnull : UnitPairsNull A) {P Q : Set ℂ} (hP : IsPreconnected P) (hQ : IsPreconnected Q) (hPA : P ⊆ {x | 0 < upperDensityAt A x}) (hQA : Q ⊆ densitySet A) : (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ Q, dist p q < 1) ∨ (∀ p ∈ P, ∀ q ∈ Q, 1 < dist p q)

name: dist_ne_one_of_mem_interior_densitySet
doc:
/-- **FS111-M2-INT**: for a measurable `A` with null unit pairs, no point of the interior of its density set is at
distance exactly `1` from a point of the closure of its density set. -/
sig: theorem dist_ne_one_of_mem_interior_densitySet {A : Set ℂ} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hnull : UnitPairsNull A) {x y : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ interior (densitySet A)) (hy : y ∈ closure (densitySet A)) : dist x y ≠ 1

name: e_pi_div_two
sig: theorem e_pi_div_two : e (π / 2) = I

name: e_neg
doc: /-- `e (−θ) = cos θ − i sin θ`. -/
sig: theorem e_neg (θ : ℝ) : e (-θ) = (Real.cos θ : ℂ) - (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * I

name: e_ne_zero
doc: /-- `e θ` is never zero (it has norm `1`). -/
sig: theorem e_ne_zero (θ : ℝ) : e θ ≠ 0

name: norm_sq_neg_one_add_e_add_e
doc: /-- Squared norm of `−1 + e u + e v`, in coordinates. -/
sig: theorem norm_sq_neg_one_add_e_add_e (u v : ℝ) : ‖(-1 : ℂ) + e u + e v‖ ^ 2 = (-1 + Real.cos u + Real.cos v) ^ 2 + (Real.sin u + Real.sin v) ^ 2

name: twoCirc_diff
doc: /-- The difference of the two turned points is `(y₁ − y₀)(−1 + e(σ s) + e(−σ t))`. -/
sig: theorem twoCirc_diff (y₀ y₁ : ℂ) (u v : ℝ) : (y₀ + (y₁ - y₀) * e u) - (y₁ + (y₀ - y₁) * e v) = (y₁ - y₀) * ((-1 : ℂ) + e u + e v)

name: ringPt_sub_ringPt
doc: /-- The chord of a unit circle as a vector: `r(β) − r(α) = 2 sin((β − α)/2) · e((α + β)/2 + π/2)`. -/
sig: theorem ringPt_sub_ringPt (p : ℂ) (α β : ℝ) : ringPt p β - ringPt p α = ((2 * Real.sin ((β - α) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * e ((α + β) / 2 + π / 2)

name: dist_ringPt_ringPt
doc:
/-- **FS116-V4-CHORD**, distance: two points of a unit circle at angular separation `δ = |α − β| ∈ [0, π]` are at
distance `2 sin(δ/2)`. -/
sig: theorem dist_ringPt_ringPt (p : ℂ) {α β : ℝ} (hδ : |α - β| ≤ π) : dist (ringPt p α) (ringPt p β) = 2 * Real.sin (|α - β| / 2)

name: norm_e_sub_e_le
doc: /-- Unit vectors are `1`-Lipschitz in the angle: `|e θ − e θ₀| ≤ |θ − θ₀|`. -/
sig: theorem norm_e_sub_e_le (θ θ₀ : ℝ) : ‖e θ - e θ₀‖ ≤ |θ - θ₀|

name: dist_ringPt_ringPt_cmp_one
doc:
/-- **FS116-V4-CHORD**, the three regimes: at separation `δ ∈ [0, π]` the distance is `1` exactly at `δ = π/3`, below
`1` for `δ < π/3`, above `1` for `π/3 < δ`. -/
sig: theorem dist_ringPt_ringPt_cmp_one (p : ℂ) {α β : ℝ} (hδ : |α - β| ≤ π) : (dist (ringPt p α) (ringPt p β) = 1 ↔ |α - β| = π / 3) ∧ (dist (ringPt p α) (ringPt p β) < 1 ↔ |α - β| < π / 3) ∧ (1 < dist (ringPt p α) (ringPt p β) ↔ π / 3 < |α - β|)

name: twoCirc_identity
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR1-TWOCIRC**: let `|y₀ − y₁| = 1` and let `p = y₀ + (y₁ − y₀) e(σπ/3)` (`σ = ±1`: `p` is the third vertex
of a unit equilateral triangle on `y₀y₁`, and `σ` is the turning sense "toward `p`"); put
`a(s) = y₀ + (y₁ − y₀) e(σ s)` (from `y₁`, turning `s` about `y₀` toward `p`) and `b(t) = y₁ + (y₀ − y₁) e(−σ t)`
(from `y₀`, turning `t` about `y₁` toward `p`). Then
`|a(s) − b(t)|² − 1 = −8
sig: theorem twoCirc_identity {y₀ y₁ : ℂ} (h01 : dist y₀ y₁ = 1) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (s t : ℝ) : ‖(y₀ + (y₁ - y₀) * e (σ * s)) - (y₁ + (y₀ - y₁) * e (-(σ * t)))‖ ^ 2 - 1 = -8 * Real.sin (s / 2) * Real.sin (t / 2) * Real.cos ((s + t) / 2) ∧ ‖(y₀ + (y₁ - y₀) * e (σ * s)) - (y₁ + (y₀ - y₁) * e (-(σ * t)))‖ ^ 2 - 1 = 2 * (1 - Real.cos s) * (1 - Real.cos t) - 2 * Real.sin s * Real.sin t

name: twoCirc_cmp_one
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR1-TWOCIRC**, the regimes: for `0 < s, t < π`, `|a(s) − b(t)|` is below `1` when `s + t < π`, equal to `1`
when `s + t = π`, above `1` when `s + t > π`. -/
sig: theorem twoCirc_cmp_one {y₀ y₁ : ℂ} (h01 : dist y₀ y₁ = 1) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hs' : s < π) (ht : 0 < t) (ht' : t < π) : (s + t < π → dist (y₀ + (y₁ - y₀) * e (σ * s)) (y₁ + (y₀ - y₁) * e (-(σ * t))) < 1) ∧ (s + t = π → dist (y₀ + (y₁ - y₀) * e (σ * s)) (y₁ + (y₀ - y₁) * e (-(σ * t))) = 1) ∧ (π < s + t → 1 < dist (y₀ + (y₁ - y₀) * e (σ * s)) (y₁ + (y₀ - y₁) * e (-(σ * t))))

name: exists_sign_of_equilateral
doc:
/-- The row's hypothesis read back: every `p` with `|p − y₀| = |p − y₁| = 1 = |y₀ − y₁|` is `y₀ + (y₁ − y₀) e(σπ/3)`
for one of `σ = ±1`, so `twoCirc_identity` covers every configuration the row names. -/
sig: theorem exists_sign_of_equilateral {y₀ y₁ p : ℂ} (h01 : dist y₀ y₁ = 1) (hp0 : dist p y₀ = 1) (hp1 : dist p y₁ = 1) : ∃ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) ∧ p = y₀ + (y₁ - y₀) * e (σ * (π / 3))

name: xcorner
doc:
/-- **FS121-D1-XCORNER**: at a convex corner `z` of angle `θ ∈ (0, π)` with straight edges along `e(φ)` and
`e(φ + θ)`, the inner unit parallels of the two edges (`z + s e(φ) + e(φ + π/2)` and `z + t e(φ + θ) + e(φ + θ − π/2)`)
meet exactly when `s = t = cot(θ/2)`, at the point at distance `1/sin(θ/2)` from `z` on the bisector. -/
sig: theorem xcorner {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ' : θ < π) (z : ℂ) (φ : ℝ) (s t : ℝ) : (z + s * e φ + e (φ + π / 2) = z + t * e (φ + θ) + e (φ + θ - π / 2) ↔ s = Real.cot (θ / 2) ∧ t = Real.cot (θ / 2)) ∧ z + (Real.cot (θ / 2) : ℂ) * e φ + e (φ + π / 2) = z + ((1 / Real.sin (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * e (φ + θ / 2)

name: subset_densitySet_of_isOpen
doc: /-- Every point of an open set is a density point of it. -/
sig: theorem subset_densitySet_of_isOpen {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) : U ⊆ densitySet U

name: dist_ne_one_of_mem_of_mem_closure
doc:
/-- **FS129-SR2-CLOSURE**: if `U ⊆ ℝ²` is open with `(Leb ⊗ σ){(x, w) ∈ U × S¹ : x + w ∈ U} = 0`, no point of `U` is at
distance exactly `1` from a point of `cl U`. -/
sig: theorem dist_ne_one_of_mem_of_mem_closure {U : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hnull : UnitPairsNull U) {x y : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ U) (hy : y ∈ closure U) : dist x y ≠ 1

name: dist_lt_one_of_isPreconnected
doc:
/-- The engine: on a preconnected set `S` holding one point `s₀` nearer than `1` to `x`, if no point of `S` is at
distance exactly `1` from `x`, every point of `S` is nearer than `1` to `x` (`x` need not lie in `S`). -/
sig: theorem dist_lt_one_of_isPreconnected {S : Set ℂ} (hS : IsPreconnected S) {x s₀ : ℂ} (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ S) (h0 : dist x s₀ < 1) (h : ∀ s ∈ S, dist x s ≠ 1) : ∀ s ∈ S, dist x s < 1

name: dist_lt_one_of_forall_dist_ne_one
doc:
/-- **FS106-DIAM (i)**: a connected set with no two points at distance `1` has every two points nearer than `1`
(the row's "diameter ≤ 1", pointwise and strict). -/
sig: theorem dist_lt_one_of_forall_dist_ne_one {S : Set ℂ} (hS : IsPreconnected S) (h : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, dist x y ≠ 1) : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, dist x y < 1

name: chain_step
doc: /-- One link of a chain: if `V` lies within `1` of `x` and `V'`'s closure meets `V`'s, so does `V'`. -/
sig: theorem chain_step {W V V' : Set ℂ} (hW : IsOpen W) (hnull : UnitPairsNull W) (hV : V ⊆ W) (hV' : V' ⊆ W) (hV'c : IsPreconnected V') {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ W) (hnear : ∀ s ∈ V, dist x s < 1) (hmeet : (closure V ∩ closure V').Nonempty) : ∀ s ∈ V', dist x s < 1

name: dist_lt_one_of_chain
doc:
/-- **FS106-TS-C**: a chain `U 0, …, U n` of connected open regions of one colour of an almost-everywhere-proper map
(their union has null unit pairs) whose closures meet in sequence has every two points nearer than `1`. -/
sig: theorem dist_lt_one_of_chain {n : ℕ} (U : Fin (n + 1) → Set ℂ) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (hconn : ∀ i, IsPreconnected (U i)) (hnull : UnitPairsNull (⋃ i, U i)) (hmeet : ∀ i : Fin n, (closure (U i.castSucc) ∩ closure (U i.succ)).Nonempty) : ∀ x ∈ ⋃ i, U i, ∀ y ∈ ⋃ i, U i, dist x y < 1

name: dist_lt_one_of_closure_inter_nonempty
doc:
/-- **FS106-DIAM (ii)**: two connected open regions of one colour of an almost-everywhere-proper map whose closures
meet have every two points of their union nearer than `1`. -/
sig: theorem dist_lt_one_of_closure_inter_nonempty {U V : Set ℂ} (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hUc : IsPreconnected U) (hVc : IsPreconnected V) (hnull : UnitPairsNull (U ∪ V)) (hmeet : (closure U ∩ closure V).Nonempty) : ∀ x ∈ U ∪ V, ∀ y ∈ U ∪ V, dist x y < 1

name: FalconerFan
doc: /-- A Falconer fan at `k` colours with apex `a` and tip `t`. -/
sig: def FalconerFan {V : Type*} (H : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) (a t : V) : Prop

name: rhombus
doc: /-- The unit rhombus `0 – {1, 2} – 3` with the short diagonal `1 – 2`. -/
sig: def rhombus : SimpleGraph (Fin 4)

name: rhombus_falconerFan
doc: /-- **Inhabitant**: the unit rhombus is a Falconer fan at four colours with apex `0` and tip `3`. -/
sig: theorem rhombus_falconerFan : FalconerFan rhombus 4 0 3

name: falconerFan_hom
doc:
/-- **FS129-SA1-FALC-FAN**: let `k ≥ 3`, `(H, a, t)` a Falconer fan at `k` colours, and `ρ : H →g T`. (A) For every
proper `k`-colouring `C` of `T` and every colour `γ` absent from `N_T[ρ(a)]`, `C(ρ(t)) ∈ {C(ρ(a)), γ}`, and every
colour absent from `N_T[ρ(t)]` lies in `{C(ρ(a)), γ}`. (B) Every proper `(k − 1)`-colouring of `T` gives `ρ(a)` and
`ρ(t)` one colour and leaves none of its `k − 1` colou
sig: theorem falconerFan_hom {V W : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph V} {T : SimpleGraph W} {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {a t : V} (hfan : FalconerFan H k a t) (ρ : H →g T) : (∀ (C : T.Coloring (Fin k)) (γ : Fin k), (∀ x, (x = ρ a ∨ T.Adj (ρ a) x) → C x ≠ γ) → (C (ρ t) = C (ρ a) ∨ C (ρ t) = γ) ∧ ∀ δ : Fin k, (∀ x, (x = ρ t ∨ T.Adj (ρ t) x) → C x ≠ δ) → δ = C (ρ a) ∨ δ = γ) ∧ (∀ C : T.Coloring (Fin (k - 1)), C (ρ a) = C (ρ t) ∧ ∀ δ : Fin (k - 1), ∃ x, (x = ρ t ∨ T.Adj (ρ t) x) ∧ C x = δ)

name: falconerFan_chromaticNumber
doc:
/-- **FS129-SA1-FALC-DICHO-K**: a Falconer fan `(H, a, t)` at `k ≥ 3` colours has `χ(H) ≥ k − 1`, and every proper
`(k − 1)`-colouring of `H` gives `a` and `t` one colour. (The row conditions the second clause on `χ(H) = k − 1`; that
hypothesis is idle — a `(k − 1)`-colouring exists only when `χ(H) ≤ k − 1`, and then the first clause gives equality — so
the clause is stated unconditionally, which
sig: theorem falconerFan_chromaticNumber {V : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph V} {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {a t : V} (hfan : FalconerFan H k a t) : ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ H.chromaticNumber ∧ ∀ C : H.Coloring (Fin (k - 1)), C a = C t

name: finsum_update_apply
doc: /-- Repainting one vertex changes the finite sum by exactly the difference at that vertex. -/
sig: theorem finsum_update_apply {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V] {k : ℕ} (φ : V → Fin k → ℝ) (hφ : (Function.support φ).Finite) (D : V → Fin k) (u : V) (x : Fin k) : ∑ᶠ v, φ v (Function.update D u x v) + φ u (D u) = ∑ᶠ v, φ v (D v) + φ u x

name: exists_perm_pair
doc: /-- Any two ordered pairs of distinct colours are related by a permutation of the palette. -/
sig: theorem exists_perm_pair {k : ℕ} {a b i j : Fin k} (hab : a ≠ b) (hij : i ≠ j) : ∃ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin k), π a = i ∧ π b = j

name: noAffine
doc:
/-- **FS129-SA1-NOAFF-K**: let `k ≥ 2`, `ρ : G →g T`, and `φ_v : Fin k → ℝ` (all but finitely many identically zero) with
`Σ_v φ_v(C(v)) = b` for every proper `k`-colouring `C` of `G`. Then `φ_u` is constant at every `u` such that some proper
`k`-colouring of `T` leaves a colour absent from `N_T[ρ(u)]`; and if every vertex of `T` has such a colouring, every
`φ_v` is constant and `b` is the sum of
sig: theorem noAffine {V W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {T : SimpleGraph W} {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (ρ : G →g T) (φ : V → Fin k → ℝ) (hφ : (Function.support φ).Finite) (b : ℝ) (hconst : ∀ C : G.Coloring (Fin k), ∑ᶠ v, φ v (C v) = b) : (∀ u, (∃ C' : T.Coloring (Fin k), ∃ γ : Fin k, ∀ x, (x = ρ u ∨ T.Adj (ρ u) x) → C' x ≠ γ) → ∀ i j, φ u i = φ u j) ∧ ((∀ w, ∃ C' : T.Coloring (Fin k), ∃ γ : Fin k, ∀ x, (x = w ∨ T.Adj w x) → C' x ≠ γ) → (∀ v i j, φ v i = φ v j) ∧ b = ∑ᶠ v, φ v ⟨0, by omega⟩)
